metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled (the workspace name, not its ID or resource ID). Maximum 18 characters: each Data Collection Rule is named dcr-corelight-<workspace>-<log_type>, and Azure limits resource names to 64 characters. Because the longest Corelight log type is 32 characters, a workspace name longer than 18 characters makes some rule names exceed the limit and the deployment fails preflight validation with "'Name' must be between 1 and 64 characters".
Azure region of the Log Analytics workspace, for example eastus.
Full Azure resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace, in the form /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/<workspace>.
